title: CultNet Write Admitted
description: The receipt for one admitted document put or delete (write-receipt.md). Sent only after the write's commit point, only to a connection that declared the write-receipt capability, once per messageId. Map-mode: every key is written, none is nil. A receipt never carries an error, and an error.v1 never carries admission.

messageId.description: The messageId of the put or delete this admits, echoed byte for byte.

schemaId.description: The schemaId of the admitted write, echoed.

recordKey.description: The recordKey of the admitted write, echoed.
